lines.inspiration.struck: Oh. Oh, this is the best idea anyone has ever had. Everyone nearby can tell. You can hear them thinking it.
lines.inspiration.interrupted: Too loud. Too many of them, all thinking at once, and the idea went under and didn't come back up.
lines.scavenge.found: There: {item}. It was calling you. You heard it from across the street.
lines.scavenge.picked_clean: Everything here already told you everything it knows.
lines.item.used: The {item} is gone. You are fairly sure you're the one who had it.
lines.making.working: You keep at it. It's telling you where it wants the next part. It has a lot of opinions.
lines.piece.artist.solid: Done: {work}. It knows what it is. It told you.
lines.piece.artist.rough: Done: {work}. Genius. The worst parts are the most genius parts. Anyone could see that. Everyone can; you can hear them.
lines.piece.artist.botched: It was going to be {work}, and now it's something nobody has a word for, which is how you know it's important.
lines.game.words.picked: {word}. The dog next door thought of it first, to be fair.
lines.game.nerve.pressed: You keep going. The wall wants it bigger. The wall has been waiting years for this.
lines.game.karaoke.held: You mumble into the mic that you don't actually want to do this, that somebody signed you up, that it's fine, no, it's fine. It's amplified. All of it.
lines.inspiration.urge: There's a beat. It's coming from the street light. Nobody else is using it.
lines.game.rhymes.picked: {word}. It rhymes with everything. Everything rhymes, if you think about it, and you are thinking about it.
lines.making.encore: It isn't finished. It was never going to be finished. It's a cycle. You are inside the cycle.
lines.location.return: {place} again. The walls remember you. They're being polite about it.
